# doctor

Run sanity checks: python, node, skills, plugins, providers, mcp, cache, worker

```text
usage: openprogram doctor [-h] [--json] [--repair] [{credentials}]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Emit JSON |
| `topic` | credentials: report disabled credential filesystem checks |
| `--repair` | Accepted for compatibility; credential filesystem checks stay disabled |
